items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Then later on Fletcher Henderson with one of his many bands, with Red Allen, came down there too.

ctx.x: All these were White bands, yeah. And Chick Webb came down. Then later on Fletcher Henderson with one of his many bands, with Red Allen, came down there too. [INAUDIBLE FEW WORDS], and the name of the place was the Empire Ballroom. Now, anyway, I saw him there in the summers later when Benny...you know, he was with Webb (?) stayed there Benny Goodman picked it up and renamed it, and ...(?)... and all that.
Anyway, so it's good fortune. I mean, when you're young, you know, you don't think about it. "I'll write a million of them." I mean, it didn't matter. I didn't care.
